title: The canonical quotient-image page-two model
statement: For an abelian category C [def-sp-abelian], construct a FilteredPageTwoModel C [def-sp-filtered-page-two-model] whose sequence functor is the normalized canonical quotient sequence [lem-sp-filtered-complex-canonical-sequence]. Its quotient-complex maps are actual cokernel descents and its page comparisons are uniquely normalized by cycle representatives. Its differentials and naturality equations are the representative differential and induced homology-image map, for arbitrary filtered complexes.

source.document: Stacks Project, Homological Algebra and Derived Categories
source.place: Tag 012K, representative quotient-image formula and induced differential; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/012K

proof.text: Construct the quotient map by the cokernel universal property; its source substep is killed by the target projection.
The quotient-image comparison theorem and representative epis give an isomorphism uniquely determined by its representative equation. Choose this uniquely specified isomorphism.

Lift the differential of an unquotiented representative through the next filtration step. Square zero puts that lift in the target representative object. The canonical representative differential equation and homology projection naturality prove the model differential axiom.

Construct the two quotient maps from the generic restriction/projection squares. Restrict the representative map and cancel its monic inclusions to obtain the two representative naturality equations. The normalized image naturality lemma proves the model map axiom.
Assemble the functor and the named proved field equations into FilteredPageTwoModel.
